The workload uses an original `q` parameter and a replacement `region` parameter, installs that mapping, and attaches the original callable to a path operation (`tests/fixtures/workloads/dependency_lifecycle.py:36-48`). The recipe actions at `tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/dependency-lifecycle.yaml:149-214` supply the corresponding query inputs and observe HTTP status and body bytes. The identity-checked oracle artifact `parity-results/oracle/bd14cdf1-f552-4eec-8b0f-44add4a0b1f1.json` records both actions as completed under FastAPI 0.157.0 and Starlette 1.6.0. documented_sections.review_rationale: Pinned FastAPI 0.157.0 `docs/en/docs/tutorial/cookie-param-models.md:1-26` introduces grouping Cookie fields in a Pydantic model and extracting them from a request. The exact-page-evidenced case `fastapi.docs.request-schema.tutorial-cookie-param-models.cookie-model` in `tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/docs-request-schema.yaml:248-324` cites that page with kind `upstream_documentation`; its `dispatch` action sends `session-id=sid-28; theme=night` and observes status, headers, and body. FastAPI puts cookie parameters in `dependant.cookie_params` and resolves them from `request.cookies` (`fastapi/dependencies/utils.py:621-634, 776-784`). Starlette 1.6.0 parses Cookie headers into `Request.cookies` (`starlette/requests.py:149-159`); generic parsing and transport remain in the Starlette / Starlette-RS lane.

documented_sections.review_rationale: Pinned FastAPI 0.157.0 `docs/en/docs/tutorial/cookie-param-models.md:45-73` describes Pydantic `extra='forbid'` and the resulting extra-cookie validation error; the linked example configures its cookie model with that policy (docs_src/cookie_param_models/tutorial002_an_py310.py:9-14). The selected action from `tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/parameter-models-combined-locations-0157.yaml` cites this exact page with kind `upstream_documentation`, declares `CookiePreferences` with `extra='forbid'`, and sends an undeclared cookie alongside separately declared dependency fields. documented_sections.heading: A database dependency with `yield` { #a-database-dependency-with-yield }

independent_workflow_mappings.scope_note: The first response exposes a value from an async yielded in-memory session; a second request reads teardown events. This samples value injection and normal request-scope cleanup, not a database driver, transactions, or a synchronous generator dependency.

documented_sections.review_rationale: The pinned tutorial example creates a session, yields it, and closes it in `finally` (`../fastapi/docs_src/dependencies/tutorial007_py310.py:1-6`; the page describes injection and cleanup at lines 26-48). FastAPI wraps generator dependencies as context managers and enters them on the selected exit stack (`../fastapi/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py:566-574,662-672`); its routing stacks surround response creation and sending (`../fastapi/fastapi/routing.py:137-158`).

documented_sections.heading: A dependency with `yield` and `try` { #a-dependency-with-yield-and-try }

independent_workflow_mappings.scope_note: The endpoint raises a `LookupError`; the yielded dependency records the caught exception, re-raises it, and runs `finally`. A follow-up request observes the cleanup trace. The generic 500 response and application-error transport are Starlette behavior; this input uses them to expose FastAPI's dependency teardown path and does not sample exception translation or suppression.

documented_sections.review_rationale: The tutorial's `tutorial007` dependency wraps `yield` in `try/finally` (`../fastapi/docs_src/dependencies/tutorial007_py310.py:3-6`). FastAPI enters the generator as a context manager (`../fastapi/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py:566-574`) and exits its request stack around response dispatch (`../fastapi/fastapi/routing.py:137-158`), returning the endpoint exception through teardown. Starlette 1.6.0 owns the generic unhandled-error response.

documented_sections.heading: Sub-dependencies with `yield` { #sub-dependencies-with-yield }

independent_workflow_mappings.scope_note: The selected input follows one all-async, three-node yield chain, returns the leaf value, and reads cleanup afterward. Mixed return/yield graphs, arbitrary fan-out, and other graph shapes are not sampled.

documented_sections.review_rationale: The pinned example links three yielded dependencies and uses each parent value during teardown (`../fastapi/docs_src/dependencies/tutorial008_an_py310.py:6-27`). FastAPI recursively solves sub-dependencies and enters generator dependencies on their selected exit stack (`../fastapi/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py:640-680`).

documented_sections.heading: Dependencies with `yield` and `HTTPException` { #dependencies-with-yield-and-httpexception }

documented_sections.review_rationale: The pinned `tutorial008b` example catches the endpoint's `OwnerError` around `yield` and raises `HTTPException` (`../fastapi/docs_src/dependencies/tutorial008b_py310.py:16-20`; the page links this example at lines 96-114). FastAPI's generator solver is the dependency lifecycle owner (`../fastapi/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py:566-574`).

documented_sections.review_rationale: FastAPI 0.141.1 defines `Form` as a `Body` subclass with the `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` media type (fastapi/params.py:581-590), recognizes Form bodies and calls `request.form()` (fastapi/routing.py:395, 425-432), then extracts model fields and validates a top-level BaseModel (fastapi/dependencies/utils.py:912-948, 965-980). The pinned section docs/en/docs/tutorial/request-form-models.md:1-38 links the model route in docs_src/request_form_models/tutorial001_an_py310.py:9-16. Recipe docs-request-schema.yaml case fastapi.docs.request-schema.tutorial-request-form-models.form-model records that exact page and example as source evidence; its selected dispatch/openapi actions project to the listed HTTP and OpenAPI selectors. FastAPI generates the schema through `FastAPI.openapi()` (fastapi/applications.py:1070-1103). Starlette 1.6.0 owns generic URL-encoded parsing: `Request._get_form` selects `FormParser` (starlette/requests.py:296-304), which returns the parsed pairs as `FormData` (starlette/formparsers.py:105-143).

documented_sections.review_rationale: The pinned FastAPI 0.157.0 section at docs/en/docs/tutorial/request-form-models.md:41-76 explains forbidding undeclared form fields and shows the extra-field error; its included snippet is docs_src/request_form_models/tutorial002_an_py310.py:9-17, whose model sets `extra` to `forbid` and whose route uses `Annotated[FormData, Form()]`. The existing input-only case fastapi.docs-example-wave-f.request-form-models.extra-forbidden selects strict-form-model-annotated, which sends declared username/password fields and an independent `unexpected` field to the workload's matching StrictLoginForm configuration and Annotated route (tests/fixtures/workloads/request_form_upload_source_review_independent.py:17-20,217-221). That action observes recipe selectors `status` and `body`, projected here to `http.status` and `http.body.bytes`; the recipe contains no expected output. FastAPI 0.157.0 calls `request.form()` for Form bodies (fastapi/routing.py:398-457), extracts model fields and retains remaining form keys before model validation (fastapi/dependencies/utils.py:1080-1127, 1162-1206); Pydantic owns rejection under the model's `extra=forbid` configuration. Starlette 1.6.0 is the sole generic form-parsing oracle: `Request._get_form` selects `FormParser` for URL-encoded input (starlette/requests.py:296-310), and the parser returns the received name/value pairs as `FormData` (starlette/formparsers.py:105-143). The checked FastAPI source checkout is pinned at 0.157.0 commit 386a28af2f87af1a32ac26d88f07b7f58ab2dfb1; Starlette remains pinned at 1.6.0 commit 4f250d6b814587e20c5365f0a5f0c4d42bcb929f.

case_designs.stimulus_design_notes: Request-parameter source review links these partial input cases: tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/parameter-runtime-defaults.yaml::fastapi.parameter-runtime-defaults.file-default-factory (actions: request; selectors: http.body.bytes, http.status); tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/parameter-runtime-defaults.yaml::fastapi.parameter-runtime-defaults.file-default-factory-provided (actions: request; selectors: http.body.bytes, http.status); tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/request-multipart.yaml::fastapi.request-multipart.file.optional-missing (actions: dispatch; selectors: http.body.bytes, http.status); tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/request-multipart.yaml::fastapi.request-multipart.file.optional-present (actions: dispatch; selectors: http.body.bytes, http.status); tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/request-optional-upload-alias-validation-alias-review.yaml::fastapi.request-optional-upload.alias-validation-alias.source-review (actions: optional-upload-python-name, optional-upload-declared-alias, optional-upload-validation-alias, optional-upload-openapi-schema; selectors: http.body.bytes, http.status, openapi.document, openapi.paths); tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/request-optional-upload-alias-validation-alias-review.yaml::fastapi.request-optional-upload.optional-missing-doc-example (actions: optional-upload-missing; selectors: http.body.bytes, http.status); tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/request-optional-upload-alias-validation-alias-review.yaml::fastapi.request-optional-upload.alias-validation-alias.source-review (actions: optional-upload-declared-alias, optional-upload-openapi-schema, optional-upload-python-name, optional-upload-validation-alias; selectors: http.body.bytes, http.status, openapi.document, openapi.paths). Inputs contain no expected results.

reviewed_mapping.contract_gate: This maps only the UploadFile path in a pinned parametrized test; the sibling bytes path is not claimed. The alias cases distinguish the Python field name, File alias, and validation_alias, and the schema case observes the independent workload's request-body projection. Multipart framing and UploadFile parsing remain Starlette 1.6.0 / Starlette-RS-owned; the workflow does not establish full test-module behavior.
reviewed_mapping.rationale: The pinned schema function checks both bytes and UploadFile routes; this link covers only the independent optional UploadFile route and observes its validation-alias request schema.

fixture_designs.stimulus_design_notes: Pydantic 2.13.5 owns BaseModel field metadata, union-branch validation and coercion, Annotated Tag/Discriminator interpretation, validation error items, and model JSON Schema. FastAPI owns Python endpoint annotation inspection, deciding that these declarations are request bodies or forms, applying request/error locations and endpoint context, and placing the generated field schema into an OpenAPI operation. No Pydantic internals are claimed as FastAPI-RS behavior by this mapping. Starlette 1.6.0 is the sole contract for ASGI request/response transport, URL-encoded form parsing, generic route/mount scope behavior, exception middleware, and TestClient encoding and re-raising. FastAPI owns body/form parameter binding, validation exception context and OpenAPI operation composition. The error-context workflows observe the ASGI exception directly; fastapi.validation-error-context.exact.websocket-error-fields covers one rethrowing WebSocket-handler path. It does not claim TestClient transport or all handler and re-raising behavior. The original FastAPI tree is a development/oracle source only. Every FastAPI behavior described here belongs in fastapi-rs Rust control flow. The target Python runtime may only directly re-export native symbols and declare literal __all__; fastapi-rs-py is limited to PyO3 binding and value conversion. The Starlette 1.6.0 replacement has a separate Rust contract; Pydantic 2.13.5 remains the pinned model/validation/schema authority.; Request-parameter source review links these partial input cases: tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/request-models.yaml::fastapi.request-models.union-body.test-post-item (actions: dispatch; selectors: http.body.bytes, http.status); tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/union-body-tutorial-review.yaml::fastapi.request-union-body.tutorial.other-item (actions: post-other-item; selectors: http.body.bytes, http.status); tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/union-body-tutorial-review.yaml::fastapi.request-union-body.tutorial.item (actions: post-item; selectors: http.body.bytes, http.status); tests/fixtures/input-recipes/parity/union-body-tutorial-review.yaml::fastapi.request-union-body.tutorial.openapi (actions: union-body-openapi; selectors: docs.response.status, http.status, openapi.document). fixture_designs.stimulus_design_notes: Pydantic 2.13.5 owns BaseModel field metadata, union-branch validation and coercion, Annotated Tag/Discriminator interpretation, validation error items, and model JSON Schema. FastAPI owns Python endpoint annotation inspection, deciding that these declarations are request bodies or forms, applying request/error locations and endpoint context, and placing the generated field schema into an OpenAPI operation. No Pydantic internals are claimed as FastAPI-RS behavior by this mapping. Starlette 1.6.0 is the sole contract for ASGI request/response transport, URL-encoded form parsing, generic route/mount scope behavior, exception middleware, and TestClient encoding and re-raising. FastAPI owns body/form parameter binding, validation exception context and OpenAPI operation composition. The error-context workflows observe the ASGI exception directly; fastapi.validation-error-context.exact.websocket-error-fields covers one rethrowing WebSocket-handler path. It does not claim TestClient transport or all handler and re-raising behavior. The original FastAPI tree is a development/oracle source only. Every FastAPI behavior described here belongs in fastapi-rs Rust control flow. The target Python runtime may only directly re-export native symbols and declare literal __all__; fastapi-rs-py is limited to PyO3 binding and value conversion.
